welcome.title: ClawX Chat
welcome.subtitle: What can I do for you?

fileCard.openWithFailed: Could not open file with the selected application
fileCard.revealFailed: Could not show file in its folder

insufficientQuota.title: Insufficient balance
insufficientQuota.message: This request was not run because the account has insufficient quota. You can continue immediately after recharging.

authInvalid.title: Sign-in credentials expired
authInvalid.message: Sign in again or check the API key before sending another request.

rateLimit.title: Too many requests
rateLimit.message: The service is temporarily rate-limited. Send the request again shortly.

permissionDenied.title: Permission denied
permissionDenied.message: This account or model cannot perform the request. Check its access settings.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.message: The service did not respond in time. Send the request again shortly.

network.title: Network connection interrupted
network.message: The connection closed during the request. Check the network and send it again.

serviceUnavailable.title: Model service unavailable
serviceUnavailable.message: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable. Send the request again shortly.

sessionLocked.title: Session temporarily unavailable
sessionLocked.message: The session file is in use. Refresh the chat, or create a new chat if it does not recover.

modelUnavailable.title: Model unavailable
modelUnavailable.message: No configured account currently supports this model. Switch models or contact the administrator.

contentPolicy.title: Content safety check failed
contentPolicy.message: The generation was blocked by a safety policy. Revise the prompt and send it again.

conversationInvalid.title: Conversation context invalid
conversationInvalid.message: The model cannot continue this conversation context. Create a new chat and try again.

imageTooLarge.title: Image too large
imageTooLarge.message: The image is still larger than 6 MiB after compression. Choose a smaller image and send it again.

invalidRequest.title: Invalid request parameters
invalidRequest.message: Adjust the request using the reason below, then send it again.

unknown.title: Model call failed
unknown.message: The request could not be completed. Try again shortly or contact support if it continues.

acp.imagePreviewFailed: Unable to load the full-size image
acp.imagePreviewDescription: Full-size preview of the generated image
acp.videoLoadFailed: Unable to load the local video

changes.heading: File changes ({{count}})
changes.empty: This session has no file changes yet.
changes.selectFileHint: Click a file card in the chat or “View changes” to open a diff.

preview.emptyHint: Click a file card in the chat first; the selected file will preview here.

errors.absolutePath: Local paths must use a file:/// URL.
errors.unsupportedProtocol: This URL protocol is not supported.
errors.reservedUrl: This internal URL cannot be opened.
errors.openExternalFailed: Failed to open the page in the system browser.

crash.title: Web Browser stopped
crash.message: The browser page closed unexpectedly. Its navigation history and page state were lost.

errors.outsideSandboxHint: ClawX could not read this path. The file may have been moved or deleted, or the current account may not have permission. You can still reveal it in the file manager.
errors.readOnlyRoot: File lives in a read-only location (e.g. bundled skill) and cannot be modified
errors.noPreview: No preview available for this file
errors.unsupportedFormatTitle: This file format is not supported for built-in preview or diff
errors.unsupportedFormatHint: Built-in preview and diff currently support directly readable text/Markdown-style files only. Open the file in the file manager instead.
errors.largeBinaryOpenTitle: This file is too large for built-in preview
errors.largeBinaryOpenHint: This file is {{size}}. ClawX cannot preview it inline, but you can confirm and open it with the system default app.

diff.newFile: New file — no original to compare
diff.tooLarge: File too large — diff view disabled, switch to the Source tab to view the full content
diff.unavailable: The current chat did not capture a precise baseline for this file, so no diff is available.
diff.unavailableHint: Use the Preview tab for the current file; use Git or another VCS for an exact diff.

confirmOpen.title: Open file

confirmOpen.detail: This file will be opened with the system default application.

workspace.pickFile: Select a file from the left to preview

unavailable.boundDescription: This chat's workspace may have been moved or deleted and can no longer be accessed: {{path}}
